title: Factorial Calculi and the Canonical Stirling Defect of the Prime Bhargava Factorial
summary: The classical gamma function is singled out among solutions of Euler's recurrence by the Bohr--Mollerup theorem. We develop an analogous normalization theory for the Bhargava factorial attached to the rational primes. Using factorial calculi, filtered prime-layer completion, centered cyclotomic quadrature, and orbitwise Stirling normalization, we construct a canonical zero-free entire function $\displaystyle Γ_{\mathbb P}^{\mathrm{cyc}}$ interpolating the prime Bhargava factorial.
